channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Boris Diaw | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Boris Diaw from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Grant Williams on Allen Iverson, Boris Diaw, Chuck Hayes, Draymond Green
item.description:
Grant Williams on collecting NBA trading cards:

“Allen Iverson, his market has just ballooned over the past year and a half, two years. So that was pretty cool. And then last but not least, I'm actually auctioning one of my two Allen Iverson cards in an auction here in the next couple weeks, which is exciting. I think I had a smaller Chuck Hayes card, which is kind of embarrassing to say. Listen, I love players that were my size and were playing in the league. So like Chuck Hayes, Draymond Green, Boris Diaw, those were like my favorite players growing up because they looked like me and gave me a chance.”

Grant Williams on Allen Iverson, Boris Diaw, Chuck Hayes, Draymond Green, Sep 27, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Boris Diaw
item.description:
“I don't think I coached a player that passed the ball better than Boris Diaw. Just his feel for the game,”

Quin Snyder on Boris Diaw, Mar 8, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Goran Dragic on Boris Diaw
item.description:
No. 7 Goran Dragic:

“My kid, Mateo, wore that number because he thought it was a magic number, lucky seven, you know? Usually, I’ve had No. 1 and 3 most of the time with the national team or with Houston or Phoenix. I love No. 3 just like D-Wade, but I only wore it in Houston. In Phoenix, it was taken by Boris Diaw at the time. I played with No. 1 the second time I was in Phoenix because I felt like this was a new me at the time. As a kid, I wore No. 5 and that was because of Sasha Danilovic. He was my role model growing up.”

Goran Dragic on Boris Diaw, Apr 11, 2020. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Boris Diaw
item.description:
Jeff McDonald:Pop on Boris Diaw's retirement earlier this summer:

“I've been expecting him to come back. When he runs out of money and can't pay for that boat anymore, he'll come back.”

Gregg Popovich on Boris Diaw, Sep 24, 2018. Source: Twitter @JMcDonald_SAEN.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Boris Diaw
item.description:
Andy Larsen:Pop on trading away Boris Diaw:

“It made our dinners a lot less fun. He was one of the only guys who would drink with me.”

Gregg Popovich on Boris Diaw, Apr 12, 2017. Source: Twitter @andyblarsen.

item.title: Nicolas Batum on Tony Parker, Boris Diaw
item.description:
“The team needs it. Everybody’s pushing me here. When Tony Parker didn’t play with us this summer, Boris Diaw and I had to step up our games. That was a cool learning experience for me. Here, we’re all young and I would like to be the guy for LaMarcus and Damian. I would like that a lot. But I know I need to be aggressive, and it is coming.”

Nicolas Batum on Tony Parker, Boris Diaw, Dec 18, 2014. Source: RealGM.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Boris Diaw
item.description:
Chris Mannix:Pop on Boris Diaw:

“Boris is having pina coladas. We have a pool where you guess his weight. You have to start at 275.”

Gregg Popovich on Boris Diaw, Sep 26, 2014. Source: Twitter @ChrisMannixSI.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Boris Diaw
item.description:
Dan McCarney:Interesting quote from Popovich on Diaw:

“He's such a versatile player, I'm still learning how to use him.”

Gregg Popovich on Boris Diaw, Jun 3, 2014. Source: Twitter @danmccarneysaen.

item.title: Tony Parker on Boris Diaw
item.description:
Tony Parker:

“Our training camp? It's just so that Boris Diaw can get in shape.”

Tony Parker on Boris Diaw, Jul 13, 2011. Source: BasketSession.com.
